  -- Thought: Confirmed that "Back to December" by Taylor Swift is a country pop ballad and that Yoann Lemoine directed its video. This matches the task description.
  -- Result: Provided the artist name (Taylor Swift), song title ("Back to December"), and cited Wikipedia as the source.
